Title: Orange Glazed Chicken (Saltnpiipa)

Items: 2 medium red onions, sliced into thin wedges

Preparation: Slice 2 medium red onions into thin wedges. Slice spring onions (if using) and set aside.
Mince 1 tbsp garlic and set aside.
In a jug/bowl, mix the sauce ingredients: 2/3 cup orange juice, 2 1/2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce (or hoisin), 3 tbsp honey, and 1/2 tsp chilli flakes.
Season the chicken thighs with 1 dash salt, 1 dash black pepper, and 1 tsp garlic powder.
Put 1/2 cup cornflour in a bowl/plate ready for coating (coat just before frying for best crisp).
Cooking: Coat the seasoned chicken all over with the cornflour, shaking off any excess.
Heat 1/4 cup olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Shallow-fry the coated chicken thighs for 5–6 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through. Remove chicken to a plate.
In the same pan (leave about 1 tbsp oil behind), add the sliced red onions and fry 3–5 minutes until softened and lightly caramelised at the edges.
Reduce heat to medium, add the minced garlic and stir for 15–30 seconds.
Pour in the pre-mixed sauce and simmer 1–2 minutes until slightly thickened.
Return the chicken to the pan and toss to coat in the sauce with the onions. Simmer 30–60 seconds to get everything glossy and sticky.
Top with sliced spring onions and sesame seeds to taste, then serve.
OptionalInstructions: If the pan looks dry before cooking the onions, add a small splash more oil.
Nutrition (per serving, as provided): 344 cals, 21 g protein, 12 g fat, 15 g carbs.
Customizations: Use hoisin for a sweeter, thicker glaze; use oyster sauce for a more savoury/umami glaze.
Increase chilli flakes if you want more heat.
For softer, sweeter onions: cover the pan for 2 minutes while frying the onions to help them steam.
ServingSuggestions: Serve with rice or noodles, plus a veg side like steamed broccoli or stir-fried greens.
